description: Guia de calles is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Sant Boi de Llobregat. Current street map of Sant Boi de Llobregat. It is the current official street map. It contains the official names of the streets and public roads of the municipality with the municipal code and the code of the INE. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Sant Boi de Llobregat. The portal shows the English title as "Street map guide" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Sant Boi de Llobregat. Its keywords include callejero, carrerer, urbanismo e infraestructuras, urbanisme i infraestructures, urbanism and infrastructure, streets. The listing shows 2021-05-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
